reviews.review:
Totally worth the 60 bucks, got it over the summer and I already have 505h logged, #nolife, extremlly fun though and the community is awesome! 
You don't need the DLC's to enjoy the game, but if you really think you'll need them buy them when they are on sale.

I can't connect to Multuplayer servers, I keep getting kicked out.
It says Modfied Data file.
This doesn't make sense since I am running on vanila! 

I already wrote on the discussions page but got no help.

Please someone help me,

Update:
I found the issue. It was becase of the IPV6 issue. I had to call my Internet Service Provider to ask them to change me back to IPV4

This game is amazing! I thought CoD was good when I first got it XD but this makes CoD look like childs play!

-Free roaming!
-Epic weapons and equipment you can use to destroy your enemies and save your friends!
-Many vehicles to choose from to either transport your buddies to a safezone or blow them up! (Or make them roadkill if you want to XD)
-Zeus! (A god mode where someone can edit the map and/or help and/or challenge players and customize the map and create missions! You get a new game basically every time!)
-There is a VR (Virtual Reality) that you can use to practice and hone your skills before you step out onto the battlefield, or to pick up old and rusts skills after a prolonged break!
-Excellent NPC A.I. ! though sometimes it seems a little crappy, it seems the most realistic that I have ever seen! They even react well to noise, but it is a shame that they instantly know where you are if you launch a Grenade launcher, and instead of looking where the explosion happens they shoot you in the face... Oh well, it would probably happen in real life...
- Cons - 
-Sometimes the server devs or admins could be kind of rude and kick you for the littlest mistakes...
-There is no easier difficulty for those of us who suck at games -ahem cough cough *me* cough cough-
-The Zeus is kind of difficult to get used to (in my opinion) the controls aren't very simple it seems, and it is difficult to figure out what to do and do it quickly without LOTS of practice (just an opinion, dont judge me)
-Not a very "casual" game, you can't just pick up the game and just play a little here and there, this game seems to demand a lot of time and you cant just play an hour, because nothing would probably happen, it takes a while to get anywhere and get some action, except in campaign, but the save zones are a little stretched out... just make sure you have a few hours on hand so you don't end up messing yourself up, just a suggestion. (not really a con or a pro, it's kind of in between.)
- The graphics are also cool and all, but it may take a beefy computer to run this if you want anything besides the lowest quality... or my computer just sucks... either way, it is still fun with or without seeing Joe Shmoes hair folicles XD.


All in all I would give this game a rating of 8/10 It is very fun and exciting when there is action, but it is just so boring a lot (especially in multiplayer) because you have to run around and find the people, and if youre inexperienced you will most likely get blown to bits and have to restart all over, back to where you spawned the first time... over and over.... Zeus adds a little more excitement, but sometimes you can just get a troll that wants to make everyone mad and ruin the game for everyone. All in all, I feel the purchase is worth it, especially if you plan on playing with a few friends as the servers can hold up to 100+ people in them as I have seen (just make sure your internet is good and your ping is LOW (like max should be 70 for optimal experience).

Makes a nice change from my normal choice of FPS games. Basically don't come to this looking to be an immortal super soldier, come to this with the knowledge that the best strat may be to lie mostly motionless on a rock for a while and wait
